question: Count all distinct taxa classified at the species rank in the NCBI Taxonomy.

Retrieve all taxa ancestral to Homo sapiens in the taxonomic hierarchy, including direct and indirect ancestors, and report the number of hierarchical levels separating each ancestor from Homo sapiens.

Retrieve all taxa descending from Homo sapiens in the taxonomic hierarchy, including both direct and indirect subclasses, and indicate the number of hierarchical levels separating each taxon from Homo sapiens.?
What are the species present in BioGateWay and their scientific and common names?
Which genes associated with APOC1 encode a protein, and what organism do they belong to?
Identify human genes located entirely within the genomic region between positions 43,000,000 and 44,000,000, based on their genomic start and end coordinates.
sparql:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
prefix sio: <http://semanticscience.org/resource/>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
prefix obo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/>

SELECT distinct ?s ?ini ?fin
WHERE {
 ?s rdfs:subClassOf	sio:SIO_010035 .   
 ?s obo:RO_0002162 <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCBITaxon_9606> . 
 ?s obo:GENO_0000894 ?ini .
 ?s obo:GENO_0000895 ?fin .
FILTER (?ini > 43000000 && ?fin < 44000000)
}

question: Identify the topologically associating domains (TADs) that encompass the entire BRCA1 gene locus.
sparql:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
prefix sio: <http://semanticscience.org/resource/>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
prefix obo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/>

SELECT distinct ?tad 
WHERE {
 <http://rdf.biogateway.eu/gene/9606/BRCA1> obo:GENO_0000894 ?inig .
 <http://rdf.biogateway.eu/gene/9606/BRCA1> obo:GENO_0000895 ?fing .
 ?tad rdfs:subClassOf	obo:SO_0002304 .
 ?tad obo:GENO_0000894 ?init .
 ?tad obo:GENO_0000895 ?fint .
FILTER (?inig > ?init && ?fing < ?fint)
}

question: Retrieve cis-regulatory modules that regulate BRCA1 and contribute to phenotypic conditions associated with BRCA1
Which proteins encoded by genes associated with “APOC1” in Homo sapiens interact with other proteins, and what are those interacting proteins?
Which proteins encoded by genes associated with “BRCA2” in Homo sapiens interact with other proteins, and what are those interacting proteins?
Which genes associated with prostate-related phenotypes encode proteins, and what biological processes are those proteins involved in?
sparql:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX obo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX sio: <http://semanticscience.org/resource/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?phen ?gene ?prot ?bp
WHERE {
    ?phen skos:prefLabel ?phenotype_label .
    Filter(regex(?phenotype_label, "prostate cancer" , "i"))
     ?gene obo:RO_0002331 ?phen .
	 ?gene <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_0002162> <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCBITaxon_9606> .
     ?gene sio:SIO_010078 ?prot .
    OPTIONAL {
	?prot obo:RO_0002331 ?bp .
   } 
}

question: Which genes associated with breast cancer phenotypes have cis-regulatory modules active in particular cell lines, and which proteins do they encode?
sparql:
BASE <http://rdf.biogateway.eu/graph/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX obo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX sio: <http://semanticscience.org/resource/>
prefix biolink: <https://w3id.org/biolink/vocab/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?phen ?gene ?crm ?cell_line ?prot
WHERE {

    ?phen skos:prefLabel ?d .
    Filter(regex(?d, "breast cancer" , "i"))
    ?gene obo:RO_0002331 ?phen .
    ?crm obo:RO_0002429 ?gene .
    ?crm2gene rdf:subject ?crm .
    ?crm2gene rdf:object ?gene .
    ?inst_crm2gene rdf:type ?crm2gene .
    ?inst_crm2gene obo:TXPO_0003500 ?cell_line .
    ?cell_line biolink:category	biolink:CellLine .
    ?gene sio:SIO_010078 ?prot .
}

question: Retrieve genes for prostate cancer phenotypes, their encoded proteins, and details of prostate-active enhancers.
sparql:
BASE <http://rdf.biogateway.eu/graph/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX obo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX sio: <http://semanticscience.org/resource/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?phen ?gene ?prot ?crm ?enh_label ?enh_start ?enh_end ?chr ?evidence
WHERE {

?phen skos:prefLabel ?d .
Filter(regex(?d, "prostate cancer" , "i"))
?gene obo:RO_0002331 ?phen .
?crm obo:RO_0002429 ?gene .
?gene sio:SIO_010078 ?prot .
?crm rdfs:subClassOf obo:SO_0000727 .
?crm skos:prefLabel ?enh_label .
?crm obo:GENO_0000894 ?enh_start .
?crm obo:GENO_0000895 ?enh_end .
?crm obo:BFO_0000050 ?chr .
?enh_inst rdf:type ?crm .
?enh_inst	obo:TXPO_0003500 ?evidence .	
}
